identity: Frederick Fox, Annexus (1980), alto saxophone and prepared piano, commissioned and dedicated to Thomas Liley.
findings: Gregory E.Miller's2008University of North Texas dissertation documents1980composition,Dorn1988publication,approximately10minutes,single movement.
Prepared piano requires bow hairs threaded beneath selected strings before performance; other piano effects include muted strings,palm contact,fingertip glissandi and keyboard clusters.
Saxophone techniques include minor-second and quarter-tone lip glissandi,two highest-possible altissimo gestures,growl or flutter tongue,and slow wide vibrato.
Dissertation gives Thomas Liley and Robert Frascotti Roncorp1983recordings; Liley album title is inconsistent across dissertation sections,so retain as archival leads only.
